projectDescription: A Compose Multiplatform library that renders Apple Music-style karaoke and synced lyrics with syllable-level animations, multi-voice duet support, and breathing dot interludes.
keyFeatures: Syllable-level karaoke fill gradient animations inspired by Apple Music
Character-level bounce, dip-and-rise, and swell animations for slow syllables
Multi-voice and duet support with animated accompaniment line visibility
Breathing dots composable for instrumental intros and interludes
Synced line (LRC/non-karaoke) rendering with RTL support
Balanced line-breaking algorithm for aesthetically wrapped lyrics
Spring-physics-based list item placement with LookaheadScope
Blur effect on inactive lines with configurable blend mode (e.g., BlendMode.Plus for glow)
Translation and phonetic (ruby text) display support
Compose Multiplatform — targets Android and JVM (Desktop)
